integrity: The proof combines the published exact Fraïssé ultrahomogeneity theorem with a direct linear-inequality argument. The verifier uses exact rational arithmetic and independently checks the three-point characterization against the original diversity axiom.
scientific_limitations: The exact fiber dimension is asserted on a nonempty open stratum of strict labeled metrics, not for every boundary metric. The result is for injective ordered tuples. The dimension of the finite diversity cone and the qualitative nonuniqueness of a diversity over its induced metric are prior art; originality is restricted to the automorphism-orbit identification, exact open-fiber dimension, and first-arity consequence.
title: Metric fibers of the universal-diversity orbit space have exponentially many higher-arity coordinates
